note: Indonesian only. The /en/promo/ shell has lang=en but its UI is Indonesian and it loads this same official JSON at /id/promo/data/. The public listing filter product=Kartu Kredit is used so savings, loan, insurance, investment and M-Smile-only promos are not included. Each item slug is the offer page at https://bankmega.com/id/promo/{slug}/. The recipe lists the JSON only; detail pages are fetched separately with pipeline/fetcher.py because the JSON slug is not a URL the recipe can join onto /id/promo/data/. 12 items per page. robots.txt allows these paths.
